content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ECHS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.echs.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 02-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for ECHS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 is 02 September 2026. Candidates must ensure their application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are released in ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies have been released for Dental Hygienist / Dental Assistant / Dental Technician / Safaiwala / Driver posts under ECHS Recruitment 2026 across various polyclinics.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for ECHS Various Posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for ECHS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download, fill, and send their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for ECHS Various Posts must not exceed 56 years of age. This maximum age limit applies to all advertised positions under this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Dental Hygienist in ECHS?
faq.answer: The salary for Dental Hygienist / Dental Assistant OR Dental Technician in ECHS Polyclinic Jamnagar is Rs. 36,500/- per month. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q6. What are the qualifications required for Safaiwala post in ECHS?
faq.answer: For the Safaiwala post in ECHS Polyclinic Rajkot, candidates must be Literate. This is the minimum educational qualification specified for this position.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the ECHS Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for ECHS Various Posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for ECHS Various Posts includes Application Screening, followed by an Interview, and finally Document Verification to confirm eligibility.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for ECHS Recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification for ECHS Recruitment 2026 can be downloaded from the official website www.echs.gov.in. It contains all detailed information about the recruitment.

faq.answer: The job type for the Dental Hygienist / Dental Assistant / Dental Technician / Safaiwala / Driver posts under ECHS is Contractual. These positions are offered on a contract basis.
